resources.string: AntiGolem provides a visible floating toolkit over the Android launcher and apps after you explicitly enable this service. Circle Select is a true freehand lasso: you draw any closed shape with your finger and AntiGolem analyzes accessibility-visible text whose screen bounds intersect that actual drawn polygon. On Android 11+ Circle OCR can request a one-shot screenshot after the explicit freehand selection, mask everything outside the drawn shape locally, and perform bundled on-device Latin-script OCR only on the selected area. The toolkit also opens documents, manual analysis, Local AI and the full workbench. Capture and screenshots run only after an explicit toolkit action; there is no background harvesting. Protected/secure windows cannot be screenshot-scanned.
